decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression in AttachmentChips; busy is a useState local of sibling AttachButton, unbound here → ReferenceError; empty-dock return null before map and || short-circuit mean only a present occurrence in plain phase evaluates busy.

Render exception caught by the slot entry's error boundary and unmounts the whole dock subtree, not just the remove button; separate input.left attach-button entry survives; error is console-only with no user-facing banner.

Uses shipped v0.2.10 excerpt + maintainer note to establish busy pre-exists the release; proposes pre-diff plain-phase data-present mount, hover-hunk-only revert, git log -S/blame; explicitly surfaces the diff-vs-baseline inconsistency and the hoisted imageItem/status/record scope defect without over-claiming when users first hit it.

Primary fix deletes the dangling busy term (or sources owned state e.g. record.status==='uploading') preserving the phase guard; hardens record?.items ?? [], event.target?.closest?. with correct comparison, and moves imageItem into the map callback scope; warns against typeof-masking.

Specifies a data-present plain-phase mount asserting chip/remove present and no error-boundary capture (with test matrix); explains empty-state test returns null before the throwing line and node --check parses but cannot resolve free identifiers or execute the component; adds data-present slot smokes plus no-undef to pre-ship checks.
